conviction_note: The findings sum to +1.1, made of two company-document items: a below-the-line Eco Wizard insurance gain of about $13m, and an adjusted EPS that interest on $250m+ of cash should push above a thin $0.39 consensus. Against them sits a soft July-August peer read. The scaled number is smaller, (2*55/100-1)*3.5 = +0.35. p_up is held near 50 because this name has closed lower on 5 of its last 6 prints (my own Yahoo closes) and the sector has derated 11-20% since September, so a beat is not a predicted rise.
bar: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS consensus $0.39. Two sources agree: the finviz 'EPS next Q' field (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=GASS, read 2026-11-24) and the Benzinga earnings-forecasts consensus table as quoted in a search snippet (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/GASS/earnings-forecasts, stamped 2026-10-15; direct fetch was refused with a 403). Revenue consensus is $42.4M from Benzinga alone (one source), against Q2 2026's $42.9M and Q3 2025's $44.5M. Coverage is 1-2 analysts (Maxim, Buy, $14 target as of March 2026). The company gives no numeric guidance, only charter coverage: about 60% of remaining 2026 fleet days fixed and about $90M total contracted revenue as of September 2026.
positioning_check: Finviz on 2026-11-24 shows short float 0.25%, short interest 0.06M shares and short ratio (days to cover) 0.47, so there is no crowded short. Insiders hold 33.66% and institutions 36.62%. The option chain is unusable: ATM spread is 190% of mid and there is no 25d skew. Put/call OI is 0.32 on 2,297 contracts in total. The baseline gives a 20d run-up of -6.73% and is 27.2% off the 52w high. From Yahoo daily closes the stock fell from $9.49 (2026-09-02, the Q2 print day) to $7.56 (-20%), while Dorian LPG fell from $52.13 to $46.24 (-11%) over the same span. Market cap is about $281M (stockanalysis) against company-stated liquidity of 'over $250M' with zero debt.

findings.finding: Q3 GAAP should carry an Eco Wizard insurance gain of about $13M (about $0.35/share, roughly equal to the whole $0.39 consensus). Claims receivable stood at $64.24M on 2026-06-30 (Q2 balance sheet), and on the Q2 call management said it had received 'over 77 million' from the concluded Eco Wizard claim after quarter end. The Q2 income statement shows no insurance gain line; Q2 net income of $17.3M is almost all operating.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior insurance gain on this name to compare with. Vessel-sale gains, the analogous below-the-line item, have run through most recent quarters (e.g. $3.9M in H1 2026), and the print-day moves were -1.3%, -1.9%, -3.0%, +1.9% and -1.2% (my Yahoo closes for 2025-09-02, 2025-11-25, 2026-03-02, 2026-06-01 and 2026-09-02). Holders have looked through below-the-line items before.
findings.why_not_priced: No consensus I found models a gain. The $0.39 bar is below Q2's $0.46 adjusted, and an AP or Zacks headline GAAP EPS near $0.75-0.85 against $0.39 would read as a large beat. If this were priced, the stock would not have fallen 20% since the Q2 print, and a preview would quote a GAAP figure. The company will almost certainly exclude the gain from adjusted net income, which caps the effect: it is cash already disclosed in the liquidity figure, not new money.
findings.independence: The $77M figure comes from the Q2 call (https://www.webull.com/news/15511681835148288) and the $64.24M receivable from the Q2 release, two company documents. The 2026-07-07 commercial update confirms the compensation was received (https://finviz.com/news/366371/stealthgas-inc-commercial-update). The gain size is my arithmetic; the company has not stated it.

findings.finding: Adjusted EPS should come in above the $0.39 consensus, about $0.43-0.48 on my rough walk. Interest income on liquidity of 'over $250M' (up from $168.3M at June 30, zero debt) is worth about $0.02/quarter more than in Q2. Management said four of five 2026 drydockings were done in H1 (H1 drydock cost $3.0M) with one left. Q2 printed $0.46 adjusted on $42.9M revenue, and consensus revenue of $42.4M is flat, yet consensus EPS is $0.07 lower.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name sells its prints. Q2 2026 missed ($0.46 vs $0.50-0.53, revenue $42.9M vs $43.8-44.9M) and closed -1.2% on the day. Q1 2026 beat revenue ($42.8M vs $38.4M) and closed +1.9%. It closed lower on 5 of the last 6 print days (also -5.3% on 2024-11-26), all from Yahoo daily closes. Beats buy little here.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus is one or two analysts and was last visibly updated around 2026-10-15. A $0.39 bar with flat revenue implies either lower rates or costs that the drydock schedule and the bigger cash pile argue against. If the market expected a beat, the stock would not be at its September low with a 0.25% short float; but the derating is sector-wide, so this is a modest inference.
findings.independence: Shares the Q2 call with finding 1 (different facts: cost schedule and liquidity, not the gain). Consensus from Benzinga and finviz. Navigator's Q3 (finding 4) points the other way on rates.

findings.finding: Operational utilization should improve in Q3. The company's 2026-07-07 commercial update says its vessel stranded inside the Persian Gulf 'has exited the Straits of Hormuz without any incident occurring'. In Q2, when that vessel was stuck, fleet operational utilization was 82.3% against 86.3% for H1 (implying roughly 90% in Q1), and TCE was $15,709/day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Utilization is not a line this stock has visibly traded on; the print-day moves are small (median about 1.9% absolute over the last six).
findings.why_not_priced: The fact is public, but nobody has written down its utilization effect, and the $0.39 bar sits below Q2. The Q2 call also flagged more idle days for three smaller spot vessels, which partly offsets it. Sized net of that.
findings.independence: The Q2 release gives the 82.3% Q2 operational utilization (https://finviz.com/news/388132/stealthgas-inc-reports-second-quarter-and-six-months-2026-financial-and-operating-results). This feeds the same adjusted-EPS line as finding 2 but is a separate fact.

findings.finding: Peer read for the quarter is negative. Navigator Gas (handysize semi-ref and ethylene) reported Q3 2026 TCE of $30,314/day against $33,946 in Q2 (-11%) and utilization of 87.9% against 90.8%. Customers paused purchases in July and August on US-Iran diplomacy news, with utilization near 85% before recovering to 94% in September.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GASS's own TCE miss in Q2 (revenue below consensus) closed -1.2%. Rate softness has not caused large moves on print days.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer print after StealthGas last spoke (2026-09-02), so the GASS consensus may not reflect it; the $0.39 bar already sits below Q2, which may partly price it. This is a proxy: Navigator's larger semi-ref and ethylene fleet trades US Gulf flows, while StealthGas's small pressurised fleet trades Europe and Asia, and about 60% of its remaining 2026 days were on period charter.
findings.independence: Navigator's own preliminary Q3 release (https://finviz.com/news/414765/navigator-gas-announces-preliminary-third-quarter-2026-results-unaudited). Shares a document with finding 5.

findings.finding: Peer forward read is positive. Navigator guided Q4 2026 utilization and TCE higher sequentially and said LPG semi-refrigerated rates were 'firming' as the Hormuz pause reversed. That supports a firm StealthGas outlook comment and more period cover at 'historically high' rates. On the Q2 call StealthGas said charterers were reluctant to commit long-term at those levels.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: StealthGas gives no numeric guide, only coverage and commentary. On 2026-09-02 'profitability will remain elevated' came with a -1.2% day.
findings.why_not_priced: LPG shipping equities have fallen since mid-October (Dorian -16% from 2026-10-14, GASS -14%), which reads as the market pricing a softer forward market. A firm small-segment comment would cut against that. This is a proxy, not company-confirmed.
findings.independence: Same document as finding 4 (different statement: forward, not reported). Dorian LPG's Jul-Sep VLGC TCE of $96,990 (finding 9) is a broader but even less direct series.

findings.finding: The fleet keeps shrinking. Average owned vessels were 26.4 in Q2 2026 against 28.3 a year earlier, the period-end owned fleet was 26 against 29, and one more vessel held for sale ($10.5M) was due for delivery to buyers in Q3. Q3 revenue should be below Q3 2025's $44.5M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Year-on-year revenue declines from fleet shrinkage were reported in Q4 2025 (-9%, closed -3.0%) and Q2 2026 (-9%, closed -1.2%).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: consensus revenue of $42.4M already sits below Q3 2025, and the sweep lists vessel count as already in the wire. Kept small because headlines will say 'revenue down y/y' and this name has sold such headlines.
findings.independence: The Q2 call: 13 vessels sold since 2023 for about $170M and the fleet down from about 40 to 25 (https://www.webull.com/news/15511681835148288).

findings.finding: Capital allocation is a live question at this print. Liquidity is 'over $250M' with zero debt against a market cap of about $281M. On 2026-09-02 management said the Board is 'reviewing all the options', intends to 'invest in renewing the fleet' and is 'in a favorable position to deploy some of the liquidity'. It made no buybacks in H1 2026 because the shares had risen; they have since fallen 20%. About $3.8M remains on the $25M program ($21.2M used).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No special dividend in the record I found. Buyback disclosures accompanied the 2023-2025 prints; I have no clean reaction per announcement.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock trades near net cash with the ships nearly free, which says the market expects the cash to stay idle or go into newbuilds at peak prices. A buyback or special distribution would be new information; a large newbuild order would be read as negative, hence the wide band. The sign is a question, not a verdict.
findings.independence: Buyback history from the Q4 2025 release (https://finviz.com/news/326875/stealthgas-inc-reports-fourth-quarter-and-twelve-months-2025-financial-and-operating-results). Market cap from https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/gass/ (2026-11-24).

findings.finding: The stock has derated into the print with the sector and has no short base. GASS is $7.56, down from $9.49 on 2026-09-02 (-20%) and -6.7% over 20 days, while Dorian LPG is -11% over the same span (part of that is its $1.25 dividend). Short float is 0.25% and days to cover 0.47.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself. Sized 0: a drawdown that is mostly sector-explained is not evidence of overreaction, and there is no short to squeeze.
